programs.title: Moonfall
programs.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward Earth. With only weeks before impact, three unlikely heroes team up.

programs.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programs.desc: Monsieur Verdoux (Charlie Chaplin) is a suave but cynical man who supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A glimpse into the life and six-decade long career of Sir Ian McKellen, star of Richard III and X-Men, who has won many awards for his vast work in film. (S13, ep 6).

programs.title: Paris Can Wait
programs.desc: Anne takes a road trip to Paris with her husband's associate, Jacques. It is a leisurely trip until she realises that he has been using her credit card to pay their food bills. Starring: Diane Lane, Arnaud Viard, Alec Baldwin.

programs.title: Like Water For Chocolate
programs.desc: In a Mexican town around 1910, Tita falls passionately in love with Pedro, but her strict mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking.

programs.title: The Sitting Duck
programs.desc: In 2012, the head union representative of a French multinational nuclear powerhouse becomes a whistle-blower. Maureen Kearney fights government ministers to bring the scandal to light.

programs.title: Princess Caraboo
programs.desc: In the early 19th century, a mysterious young woman speaking a strange language shows up in an English village. There she is taken in by a family of aristocrats who assume she is a foreign princess.

programs.title: Angel and the Badman
programs.desc: An injured gunslinger is nursed back to health by a Quaker. When his violent past comes back to haunt him, he has to choose between her way of life and his own.

programs.title: Where The Money Is
programs.desc: Nurse Carol and her loyal husband Wayne discover that retired bank robber Henry is faking his condition. Together, they plan a heist - but as tensions rise, the robbery takes unexpected turns.

programs.title: Shaft
programs.desc: Cool private eye John Shaft is hired by a crime lord to find and retrieve his kidnapped daughter. Starring Richard Roundtree.

programs.title: Bones Of Crows
programs.desc: Bones of Crows is Aline's journey from child to matriarch, a moving multi-generational epic of resilience, survival and the pursuit of justice.

programs.title: Book Of Love
programs.desc: An uptight English writer's book is a failure but a hit in Mexico. When he's invited there to promote it, he discovers his Spanish translator has rewritten his book as an erotic novel.
